body.statement: Characterize exactly when equality of the graph law sets after projecting onto every single regime \(S\in\mathcal I\) implies equality of the joint graph law sets \(\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}(G)=\mathcal P_{\mathcal I}(H)\). Using the transition-cocycle common-lift handle, derive finite necessary-and-sufficient gluing conditions for regime-specific coefficient charts, source surjections, scaled permutations, and response maps to admit one common \(B\) and one common source-law tuple. If the implication can fail, construct the smallest exact-support latent cyclic graph pair whose every regime projection agrees but whose joint model sets differ.
body.justification: This question exposes rather than hides the new common-mechanism content that cannot be certified by independent environment fits.
body.gap: Zhou et al. unify pairwise augmented MAG constraints and Taeb et al. score shared parameters in acyclic Gaussian environments, but neither proves a lift theorem for exact-support non-Gaussian feedback law sets.
body.consumer: Multi-perturbation studies can test whether separately adequate latent models represent one invariant biological mechanism or merely unrelated regime-wise explanations.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine whether the finite exact-support graph family realizes nonempty regime-wise witness fibers with no rooted common lift and, if it does, construct and prove minimal the requested latent cyclic graph pair.
obligation.obstruction: The finite fiber criterion is exact and decidable, but neither the frozen primitives nor the audited presolve supply a graph pair or a structural theorem forcing the rooted intersection property.  General semialgebraic fibers can fail to intersect, while that fact alone does not prove realizability by exact-support feedback graphs.
obligation.attempted: Reduced every regime projection to residual source-partition fibers, used the observational regime as a root, and proved that one observational partition plus simultaneous response equalities is necessary and sufficient for a common mechanism.  Audited the square no-latent matching reduction; there, fixing every atomic row separately strongly constrains the matching and did not furnish a valid counterexample.  The supplied cycle-reversal witness was rejected for this purpose because its singleton-intervention projections already differ.
obligation.partial_result: The proved proposition on marginal gluing gives a computable necessary-and-sufficient condition: each regime separately permits its own nonempty residual source-partition fiber, whereas a joint lift exists exactly when one observational witness \((D,f,a)\) satisfies all response equalities and thereby induces every residual partition through equation (21).  The remaining unresolved subproblem is whether graph-generated exact-support fibers realize a failure of this rooted intersection and, if so, the minimum \((n,\ell,|\mathcal I|)\) and an explicit pair.
